  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos, AVG(r.review_score) AS calif, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entregas_tardias
